answer: An attacker flooding fake identities must lock real capital per account, and a rising tide of duplicate registrations triggers slashing of the whole cluster. To mitigate sybils, each agent must stake a bonded relic token locked for several epochs; joining requires a unique proof-of-personhood attestation tied to that stake. The registry acts as a haven for verified participants, while the bonded relic makes mass forgery economically ruinous. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
